sql: with tw as (select market_ticker, status, quantity, assumed_price, round(pnl::numeric,2) as twin_pnl from paper_trades where strategy='Nmmsell10_pt4'), lv as (select market_ticker, bool_or(status='filled') as live_filled, sum(case when status='filled' then quantity else 0 end) as live_qty, max(limit_price) as live_px from live_orders where strategy='Nmmsell10' group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from tw) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select tw.market_ticker, tw.status as twin_status, tw.assumed_price as twin_px, tw.twin_pnl, lv.live_filled, lv.live_qty, lv.live_px, p.pos as acct_pos, p.realized_pnl as acct_realized from tw left join lv using (market_ticker) left join p using (market_ticker) order by tw.market_ticker
